title: Lior and the Cipher
author: Vesper Quintana
blurb: Dominic Iversen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
